description: Image Description: The image depicts an urban street scene. In the foreground, there is a maroon car parked on the street. Behind it, a white car is parked on the opposite side. A signpost in the foreground is covered with various stickers and has a no-parking sign attached. In the background, there is a building with graffiti on the facade, including the words "WIR BLEIBEN" painted across the upper part. The building has multiple windows, some of which are open
